rubrics.justification: Description is largely consistent with a 3AB expanded blastocyst and appropriately notes strong ICM and looser TE, but some image-specific localization details are somewhat speculative.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, diagnosis, prior cycle, sperm parameters, BMI, and endometrium with embryo quality and prognosis.
Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with a plausible probability estimate, though a few adjustment steps are somewhat heuristic and not strongly evidence-anchored.

Mostly aligned on SET and general embryo assessment, but recommendations such as routine low-dose aspirin, ERA/ReceptivaDx after limited failure history, and strong PGT-A endorsement at age 33 are more debatable and not standard guideline-based.
Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer and contingency planning, though some suggested adjuncts may be overly aggressive for this clinical scenario.
